reaction: The changing pockets at minus 30 are surprising and make preserving the setting around the body feel consequential.

mostWorthwhile.text: Warming the adjacent section made the preservation problem concrete: material moves even while the ice looks solid.

leastWorthwhile.text: Preparing the section was a bare creation message; I wanted a little more sense of how the sample was taken while protecting the body.

surprise.text: Fine pockets change and material moves at minus 30 while the piece still looks solid.

arbitrary.text: Neither action lacked a clear purpose, but both were the only offered gameplay choices, so I did not feel I was deciding how to conduct the experiment.

continue.text: Yes. I want to see how the carrier keeps the specimen cold enough and what happens when the discovery reaches Earth, although I would hope for more meaningful choices.
